data.name: KbActive
data.value: Windows key hook: active. A lone Win key opens Machitan's Start; Win combinations pass through to Windows.

data.name: KbActiveNoStart
data.value: Windows key hook: active, but Machitan's Start is not available, so a lone Win key opens Windows' Start.

data.name: KbAdminOff
data.value: While an app running as administrator is in front, Windows keeps the keys from Machitan (turn on "Shortcuts in apps running as administrator" below). If the Win key opens Windows' Start there, Machitan closes it and opens its own.

data.name: KbAdminOn
data.value: Apps running as administrator: Machitan's helper catches its shortcuts there too.

data.name: KbCaught
data.value: Owned by Windows, so Machitan catches them in its keyboard hook: {0}.

data.name: KbNotActive
data.value: Windows key hook: not active (error {0}). A lone Win key opens Windows' Start.

data.name: KbNotStarted
data.value: Windows key hook and shortcuts: not started (see diagnostics.log).

data.name: KbOwned
data.value: Owned by Windows, so Windows handles them as usual: {0}.

data.value: Windows asks once. A small part of Machitan then runs as administrator, only to see the keys.

data.name: SetAlwaysInPowerMenu
data.value: Always in the menu, so Machitan can always be closed from Start.

data.name: SetDragHelp
data.value: Drag to move it. Alt+Up or Alt+Down moves it with the keyboard.

data.name: SetDynalandTransparencyNote
data.value: Up to 50%, so the text stays easy to read.

data.name: SetEdgeNote
data.value: The screen edge opposite the bar.

data.name: SetFindName
data.value: Find this place and use it for the weather

data.name: SetHibernationOff
data.value: Hibernation is off on this PC.

data.name: SetInUseNone
data.value: In use: no place yet, so the weather stays hidden. Find one, or switch back to Windows' location.

data.name: SetInUseWindowsKept
data.value: In use: Windows' location. Chosen place kept for later: {0}.

data.name: SetLanguageNote
data.value: Takes effect when Machitan starts again.

data.name: SetLowBatteryNote
data.value: The battery rim turns red below this charge.

data.name: SetManualTransparencyNote
data.value: For Manual: how see-through the background is. 100% shows none.

data.name: SetModeNote
data.value: Compact is not built yet; it shows as Segmented.

data.name: SetMostUsedNote
data.value: At the top of All apps: the apps you open most from Start, counted by Machitan on this PC. Turning it off deletes the counts.

data.name: SetOwnPicturesNote
data.value: Show your own pictures on the Start button instead of Machitan's logo. They fit into the logo's place. The pressed picture stays while Start is open. Choosing the normal picture turns this on.

data.name: SetPeekDesktopNote
data.value: Rest the pointer on Show desktop for a moment to see the desktop. Move away and the windows come back.

data.name: SetPictureNoneHovered
data.value: None chosen: the hovered picture shows, or the normal one.

data.name: SetPictureNoneNormal
data.value: None chosen: the normal picture shows.

data.name: SetPicturePickFailed
data.value: The picture could not be chosen. Try again.

data.name: SetPlaceSearchFailed
data.value: The place search did not work.

data.name: SetPrivacyLog
data.value: A troubleshooting log at {0}. It can hold app names, file paths and window titles, and stays on this PC unless you share it.

data.name: SetPrivacyRing
data.value: Battery, network and volume come from Windows on this PC. The Wi-Fi name comes from Windows' network list, so no location permission is needed.

data.name: SetPrivacyWeather
data.value: With weather on, Machitan asks Windows for this PC's location at most once an hour, rounds it to about 1 km, and sends it to Open-Meteo (open-meteo.com) every 15 minutes. If Windows blocks location for desktop apps, the weather stays hidden. With a place you picked, its rounded coordinates go instead, and a place search sends the name you typed to Open-Meteo. Nothing else leaves this PC.

data.name: SetRingTransparencyNote
data.value: Auto: a soft background only where the wallpaper makes the ring hard to read.

data.name: SetSearchNote
data.value: Icon opens Windows' search; Box searches on the bar.

data.name: SetShowsWhileUpdate
data.value: Shows while an update is waiting.

data.name: SetTurnOffAnimationsNote
data.value: Start, the hidden icons (^) and the bar appear and go at once, with no motion. Turning off Animation effects in Windows (Accessibility > Visual effects) does the same.

data.name: StartEmptyCategory
data.value: No apps here yet. Right-click a pinned app and choose Move to.

data.name: StartFilesHint
data.value: Type at least two letters after files: to search your Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Pictures, Music and Videos.

data.name: StartMostUsedEmpty
data.value: The apps you open most from Start show here.

data.value: No pinned apps yet. Use ... next to an app in All apps, then Pin to Start.

data.value: Windows does not let this app be uninstalled.
